source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.6 (PDF 219), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Achhi communication (baat cheet) aur storytelling (kahani sunane ka fun) aisi zaroori skills hain jo aap ko apne khayalat bayan karne, logon se jurne aur dairpa asar (lasting impact) chhorne mein madad deti hain. Chahe aap apna koi tajurba suna rahe hon, koi concept samjha rahe hon ya kahani suna rahe hon, yeh skills parhai aur rozmarra zindagi dono mein bohat aham hain.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurs ko communication ki skill kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke woh apna idea customers, investors aur team ko itni saaf tarah samjha sakein ke un ki support (madad) mile.

items: Communication aur storytelling: khayalat bayan karna, logon se jurna, asar chhorna.
